resolved_source_issues.issue: Automatic captions become malformed while the first-order canonical condition is written.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The displayed board equation and the immediately surrounding expansion fix the condition unambiguously.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The lecture uses area preservation as the canonical criterion.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The argument is retained for one canonical pair and then sharpened to preservation of the symplectic form in higher dimensions.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The finite-generator statement is phrased globally.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The chapter states the local identity-component result: finite canonical transformations connected to the identity are composed from infinitesimal generator flows.

resolved_source_issues.issue: Mass factors are suppressed during the free-particle angular-momentum calculation.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The standard Hamiltonian p squared over 2m is retained and every derivative carries the corresponding factor of 1 over m.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The spoken final force equation omits its sign.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: Hamilton's equation is written correctly as p-dot equals minus partial U over partial q.
